name: Green Kittens Aren't Aliens
summary: Native-verified partial route collects five of 16 chips by tick 227 and parks a freed teeth against the east thin wall at (21,20). Eleven chips remain; no winning replay or impossibility proof yet.
limitations: No winning replay and no universal impossibility proof established. Data counts or unsuccessful play are not treated as impossibility.

experiments.result: Decoded both 1024-cell DAT planes and exact level metadata; initialized production MS runtime and rendered actual game sprites.
Exact DAT, seed 0, stepping 0: status playing at tick 227,11 chips remaining, Chip (22,20).

experiments.bound: 20,000 expanded nodes or 45,000 ms per local target; depth 70 four-tick inputs; nonexhaustive heuristic search
experiments.result: The first guarded-chip loop succeeded. Subsequent lower-right-room/return-anchor attempts stopped at the declared time bounds without a route; these failures do not prove impossibility.

title: Green Kittens Aren't Aliens
argument: The reusable green key at (16,26) unlocks the rooms without resource depletion. Three starting chips are safely collectible.
A short timing loop frees the teeth from the southeast inner chamber, collects its chip at (17,24), and escapes north.
A hand-derived dodge around (19,18) leads that teeth onto the east thin wall at (21,20). Its preferred south and east moves then fail while Chip reaches the chip at (22,20).
The legacy native MS oracle confirms the partial route remains playing at tick 227, Chip (22,20), with 11 chips still required. This is progress evidence, not a solution.
